profile.jobTitle: Scrum Master ~ IT Project Management ~ Agile Coach
profile.summary:
PROFESSIONAL SCRUM MASTER II (PSM II) & LEAN SIX SIGMA GREEN BELT with a proven ability to champion servant leadership, lead teams through complexity, accelerate delivery, and strengthen organizational agility. My background spans three high-impact domains—healthcare operations, software engineering, and service-industry leadership—backed by a foundation in business adminstration and high-value sales negotiation.  This cross-functional depth allows me a uniquely versatile approach to optimizing team performance, managing scope, and delivering strategic business value.

I approach Agile with deep technical empathy, having spent over three years as a software developer with experience in Decisions, Salesforce, and Microsoft architectures. I don’t just teach Scrum theory; I understand code dependencies, tech debt, and how to effectively bridge the gap between technical execution, administrative structure, and strategic business outcomes.

To drive team success, I actively leverage my top CliftonStrengths to optimize delivery workflows and human psychology:

➤ AGILE GOVERNANCE & MULTI-TEAM SCALE (Arranger & Communication)
Excel at managing multi-layered dependencies and coaching teams toward autonomous self-management. Experience coaching 3-4 cross-functional squads simultaneously, facilitating Scrum of Scrums, leading PI Planning, and converting raw Azure DevOps metrics (velocity, capacity, burn-down charts) into stable, predictable sprint delivery.

➤ IMPEDIMENT REMOVAL & SERVANT LEADERSHIP (Responsibility)
Guided by a deep sense of ownership and a servant-leader mindset, I cultivate a safe environment built on trust and transparency. I act as a protective shield for engineering teams—systematically eliminating operational, technical, and logistical bottlenecks roadblocks using Lean root-cause analysis (5 Why's) to maintain peak project velocity.

➤ STAKEHOLDER ALIGNMENT & SCOPE SHIELDING (Woo & Adaptability)
Naturally build rapid rapport and influence across departments without direct hierarchical authority. Leveraging years of high-value new contruction sales negotiations alongside complex care management, I fluidly adapt to align competing priorities, partner with Product Owners on backlog refinement, and protect sprint scope from external creep.

I am focused on enabling engineering teams to deliver value faster, collaborate more effectively, and continuously improve. Let’s connect!

📊 CliftonStrengths Top 5: Arranger | Woo | Communication | Adaptability | Responsibility

positions.title: BPM Software Developer & Co-Agile Facilitator
positions.description:
BLOCKERS & IMPEDIMENT REMOVAL: Identified and eliminated cross-team technical dependencies by facilitating Scrums and Agile forums, reducing project deployment delays for parallel tracks.

SPRINT COMMITMENT PROTECTION: Shielded the development team from external scope creep and ad-hoc stakeholder requests, maintaining a safe space for sprint commitment focus.

SERVANT LEADERSHIP & TEAM COACHING: Coached cross-functional developers on Scrum values and agile principles, fostering a self-led team dynamic that increased agile maturity and sprint predictability.

RETROSPECTIVE OPTIMIZATION: Facilitated highly collaborative Sprint Retrospectives, implementing Lean root-cause analysis and workflow automation (including AI/Copilot pairing experiments) to optimize team workflows.

SPRINT EXECUTION & DELIVERY: Partnered closely with Project Managers and Product Owners to refine, prioritize, and deconstruct backlogs, ensuring all user stories met strict Definition of Ready (DoR) and acceptance criteria.

ESTIMATION & CAPACITY PLANNING: Guided teams through comprehensive capacity planning and story-point estimation during Sprint Planning to improve forecasting accuracy.

WORKFLOW VISIBILITY: Maintained real-time visibility of work-in-progress on Azure DevOps, leveraging collaboration and mapping tools like Trello and Miro to run brainstorming sessions, lower sprint carry-over, map complex engineering dependencies, and manage release dependencies.

TECHNICAL TRANSLATION: Translated complex technical architecture constraints into clear business-value trade-offs for non-technical stakeholders.

positions.description:

IMPEDIMENT REMOVAL & CRISIS RESPONSE: Rapidly unblocked logistical, financial, and operational bottlenecks during unpredictable medical and insurance crises, maintaining operational stability.

STAKEHOLDER MANAGEMENT: Facilitated weekly status syncs and alignment workshops with family members and external vendors to drive consensus on long-term care strategies and mitigate conflicting priorities.

positions.title: Lead Bartender & Hospitality Operations Leader
positions.description:
FACILITATED DAILY OPERATIONS: Led daily shift syncs (standups) for a team of 8+ front-of-house staff to align on nightly goals and target delivery metrics. 

OPTIMIZED PROCESS FLOW & FACILITATION: Applied continuous improvement principles to analyze service bottlenecks during peak traffic hours, reducing cycle times. Mentored and coached servers directly through the service well to optimize delivery efficiency, reduce order friction, and add immediate training value to the frontline team.

MANAGED STAKEHOLDER EXPECTATIONS: Served as the frontline escalation point for high-stress customer conflicts, navigating objections calmly to protect brand reputation and stabilize the environment. 

SHIFT RETROSPECTIVES & CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT: Facilitated collaborative post-shift retrospectives with multi-bartending cohorts following peak-volume windows, gathering team feedback to isolate service friction, evaluate inventory flow, and actively tweak bar-opening and closing processes for subsequent shifts.

FRONT-OF-HOUSE RETROSPECTIVES: Led post-shift retrospective feedback loops with bartending and server teams to evaluate cross-department communication breakdowns between the kitchen and front-of-house, implementing localized workflow tweaks to lower order error rates.

BLOCKERS & IMPEDIMENT REMOVAL: Identified and eliminated cross-team technical dependencies by facilitating Scrums and Agile forums, reducing project deployment delays for parallel tracks.

SPRINT COMMITMENT PROTECTION: Shielded the development team from external scope creep and ad-hoc stakeholder requests, maintaining a safe space for sprint commitment focus.

SERVANT LEADERSHIP & TEAM COACHING: Coached cross-functional developers on Scrum values and agile principles, fostering a self-led team dynamic that increased agile maturity and sprint predictability.

RETROSPECTIVE OPTIMIZATION: Facilitated highly collaborative Sprint Retrospectives, implementing Lean root-cause analysis and workflow automation (including AI/Copilot pairing experiments) to optimize team workflows.

SPRINT EXECUTION & DELIVERY: Partnered closely with Project Managers and Product Owners to refine, prioritize, and deconstruct backlogs, ensuring all user stories met strict Definition of Ready (DoR) and acceptance criteria.

ESTIMATION & CAPACITY PLANNING: Guided teams through comprehensive capacity planning and story-point estimation during Sprint Planning to improve forecasting accuracy.

WORKFLOW VISIBILITY: Maintained real-time visibility of work-in-progress on Azure DevOps, leveraging collaboration and mapping tools like Trello and Miro to run brainstorming sessions, lower sprint carry-over, map complex engineering dependencies, and manage release dependencies.

TECHNICAL TRANSLATION: Translated complex technical architecture constraints into clear business-value trade-offs for non-technical stakeholders.

🌞 TRANSFERABLE SKILLS MAPPING: Mentored individuals over a 10-year period to identify, deconstruct, and translate hidden transferable skills, enabling successful career pivots into fields where they initially felt unqualified.
🌞 RESUME OPTIMIZATION: Partnered one-on-one with mentees to reverse-engineer complex job descriptions, architecting high-impact resumes tailored to modern recruiter screening filters.

volunteerExperience.role: Multi-Team Operations Coordinator ~ Ignite Your SuperPower STEM Day
volunteerExperience.description:
🌞 TEAM FOCUS & ENGAGEMENT FACILITATION: Supported large-scale event launch operations by proactively corralling, engaging, and routing 148 distracted student participants, successfully aligning them into their designated breakout groups to ensure a synchronized start.
🌞 CROSS-FUNCTIONAL WORKFLOW AGILITY: Acted as an adaptive operational resource across parallel technical activity tracks, migrating dynamically between groups to assist team leads ("superheroes") and resolve immediate environment friction.
🌞 PROCESS TWEAKING & LOGISTICAL ASSISTANCE: Executed tactical behind-the-scenes support to optimize mid-day resource logistics (lunch operations) and final environment cleanup, tweaking task execution on the fly to maintain schedule compliance.
🌞 TECH COMMUNITY SERVANT LEADERSHIP: Provided essential hands-on operational and pipeline support to Indy WiT’s premier flagship youth initiative, driving inclusive community execution across Indiana's technology sectors.

About the event:
❤ Students from 3 different middle schools joined us for the day at Camp Dellwood for hands-on STEM activites, Professor Steve's interactive science presentation and lunch at the Girl Scout's STEM Exploration Lab. 

IGNITE YOUR SUPERPOWER Stem Day is designed to ignite inspiration and confidence in middle school girls, discovering their own unique strengths in STEM. Students from 3 different middle schools joined us for the day at Camp Dellwood for hands-on STEM activites, Professor Steve's interactive science presentation and lunch at the Girl Scout's STEM Exploration Lab.
